summary: The PR addresses an issue with lambdify not working with MatrixSymbol names containing curly braces when dummify is True. However, there are concerns about the generality of the fix and potential impacts on other parts of the code.

issues.description: The fix appears to be specific to MatrixSymbol and may not address similar issues with other types of symbols. This could lead to future bugs if similar issues arise with other symbol types.
The change introduces additional logic for handling MatrixSymbol, which could potentially break existing behavior if not thoroughly tested across all relevant scenarios.
While the tests pass, there are no additional tests specifically added to cover the new functionality or edge cases involving MatrixSymbol with curly braces.
